long_summary: A fixed registration card above the slideshow: 'Spring 2027 registration opens Fri Nov 27' with a Registration button (one new HTML block on the home page; the whole card is the tap target and reads Register from Nov 27). The slideshow drops to four slides under it: registration (now linking to the Registration page, not a news post), new families, volunteers, and the 17-logo sponsor thank-you. Cut under Coach's 11/4 audience standard: the gear return slide (a coach task) and the Fields Committee slide (board recruiting). On phones the Little League International privacy box in the right column is hidden; the ad slot stays.
